name: Vinh Long

queries.query: Vinh Long official cadastral parcel map land information system API
queries.result: First-party results identified the official Vĩnh Long Land Registration Office, its land-data supply procedure, and the VBDLIS public land-information system. No official anonymous parcel geometry API was found in the public search results.

queries.query: Vĩnh Long bản đồ địa chính tra cứu thửa đất cổng thông tin đất đai chính thức
queries.result: Kết quả chính thức xác nhận Văn phòng Đăng ký đất đai tỉnh Vĩnh Long quản lý hồ sơ và cơ sở dữ liệu đất đai, và thủ tục cung cấp dữ liệu đất đai qua Văn phòng/Cổng thông tin đất đai. Không tìm thấy phản hồi hình học thửa đất công khai, ẩn danh.

registryBasis: The official provincial portal identifies the Vĩnh Long Land Registration Office as responsible for registration, cadastral records, land databases, and supplying land information; the official procedure describes requests through that office or the land-information portal. This is a local/provincial registry custodian, distinct from general national-agency prose.

requests.outcome: Official provincial portal loaded. It exposed general administrative content and a CAPTCHA-backed feedback area; no anonymous parcel layer or API was advertised in the retrieved page.
Official registry-office page returned custodian functions, including managing cadastral records/databases and supplying land information. No parcel geometry response was present.

Public VBDLIS shell loaded. Current JavaScript bundle was inspected for service URLs, API routes, WMS/WMTS, parcel/thửa endpoints, and Vĩnh Long configuration; no anonymous parcel geometry route was exposed. The site is not treated as a successful parcel query.

Current public JavaScript/configuration bundle retrieved and inspected. It contains VBDLIS informational/application content but no usable anonymous ID-plus-geometry response for Vĩnh Long. No login, CAPTCHA bypass, credential, or private token was attempted.
Official procedure document returned. It describes land-data requests and responsible offices/portal, but is procedural evidence only and contains no safe anonymous parcel geometry sample.
